sloka: ददौ तस्य ततः प्रीतः स्व नामांक उपशोभितम् ।अंगुलीयम् अभिज्ञानम् राजपुत्र्याः परंतपः ॥४-४४-१२॥
transliteration: dadau tasya tataḥ prītaḥ sva nāmāṁka upaśobhitam ।aṁgulīyam abhijñānam rājaputryāḥ paraṁtapaḥ ॥4-44-12॥

translations.english: Rama, scorcher of enemies, gladly gave Hanuman a ring inscribed with his name as a mark of identification by princess (Sita). And said:
